description.html: Gecko Nutrition Mango is a complete powdered diet for crested geckos, made in Germany. Mango adds natural sweetness and a tropical taste, while banana forms the base of the fruit part, so most geckos accept it readily.

The main ingredients are banana 28%, insects 11% (black soldier fly larvae, mealworms and crickets) and mango 10%, complemented by whey protein and casein, pea protein, whole grain rice, coconut, bee pollen, honey, carrot, beetroot and spirulina. Vitamins A, D3 and B vitamins are added, along with iron, selenium and manganese.

Mix 1 part powder with 2 parts water (by volume). The mix is runny at first but thickens within a few minutes to a ketchup-like consistency; you can adjust the ratio slightly. The manufacturer recommends feeding 2-3 evenings a week, and leftovers should be removed after 24 hours. Store the opened pack in a cool, dry place; prepared food keeps 3-4 days in the fridge.
Besides crested geckos, it also suits other fruit-eating reptiles. Read more about feeding on our lizard food page.
